subject.title: [Bug] Silent fail-open when Tailscale interface binding fails on gateway start

question: When an explicit `gateway.bind=tailnet` cannot obtain a Tailscale address, should startup fail closed or enter a supported, visibly degraded loopback-only state?
rationale: Current behavior trades requested reachability for availability while crossing into the documented local-loopback trust model; repository policy treats fallback and bind/auth behavior as explicit product and security decisions.

options.title: Fail explicit Tailnet startup
options.body: Abort with a non-zero exit and actionable Tailscale diagnostics whenever an explicitly requested Tailnet address is unavailable.

options.title: Support degraded loopback
options.body: Continue only on authenticated loopback while emitting prominent startup, readiness, and status signals that Tailnet reachability was not established.

recommendation.title: Fail explicit Tailnet startup
recommendation.body: Abort with a non-zero exit and actionable Tailscale diagnostics whenever an explicitly requested Tailnet address is unavailable.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue timeline explicitly routes and subscribes `steipete` to this gateway security-boundary decision.
